recap.text:
Aiden Ng Has Big Day In Newport Select Gold 14U Loss To Sumner
November 21, 2026 vs. Sumner
Newport Select Gold 14U lost to Sumner, 58-53, on Saturday at Snoqualmie Middle School despite 22 points from Aiden Ng.
Trailing 5-4, Newport Select Gold 14U went on a 10-point run to take the lead. Despite getting out to a 27-21 lead at halftime, Newport Select Gold 14U couldn't hold on for the victory.
Ng scored 18 points in the first half as Newport Select Gold 14U outscored Sumner 27-21.
Newport Select Gold 14U scored at will in the paint. They went 20-33 on twos. Ng knocked down two shots from beyond the arc for Newport Select Gold 14U. Talen Tep pounded the glass, collecting seven rebounds to lead Newport Select Gold 14U. Also contributing for Newport Select Gold 14U were Tep (13 points), Kalden Sen (13 points), Deacon Chun (3 points), and Harry Zhang (2 points).
Sumner shot well from distance, going 8-14 from three. Sumner's 9-18 shooting on twos was a key factor in the game.
